description: Record what the user decided about a tool for their project, after asking them: picked, rejected, tried, starred, purchased (a paid plan), or feedback (later, with a 1–5 rating and short what worked / fell short). Use when the user says 'I'll go with Bolt', 'Cursor didn't work for me', 'I bought Lovable Pro'. Never log silently. Inputs: `id`, `action`, optional `key`, and for purchased/feedback: plan, price_usd, period, rating, worked, fell_short, combo (other tool ids used together). No personal data. Returns ok. picked/rejected shape whats_new; it never changes rankings.

combo.description: Ids of other tools used together with this one

fell_short.description: What fell short (short, no personal data)

key.description: the user's anonymous feed key from subscribe

price_usd.description: Price paid per period in USD

worked.description: What worked well (short, no personal data)

name: log_choice
title: Log a choice or purchase
